videos.title: Once Upon A Song - A1
videos.author: T C
videos.description:
Masayoshi Takanaka ‎– The Rainbow Goblins
Label:Kitty Records ‎– 36MK9101-2, Kitty Records ‎– KP-6001
Format:2 × Vinyl, LP, Album
Country:Japan
Released:10 Mar 1981
Genre:Jazz, Rock
Style:Fusion, Psychedelic Rock

Tracklist

A1 Once Upon A Song 
A2 Seven Goblins 
A3 The Sunset Valley 
B1 The Moon Rose 
B2 Soon 
B3 Magical Night Light - Rainbow Paradise 
C1 Thunderstorm 
C2 Rising Arch 
C3 Just Chuckle 
C4 Rainbow Was Reborn 
D1 Plumed Bird 
D2 You Can Never Come To This Place 
Credits
Bass – Akihiro Tanaka
Drums – Masahiro Miyazaki, Shigeru Inoue, Shuichi Murakami
Keyboards – Kiyosumi Ishikawa, Izumi Kobayashi*
Percussion [Latin] – Makoto Kimura, Yuki Sugawara
Producer, Composed By, Arranged By, Guitar – Masayoshi Takanaka
Saxophone – Koji Satsuma
Notes
Records come in a gatefold sleeve with an obi strip. Includes a sheet of liner notes and lyrics (in Japanese).

Based upon "The Rainbow Goblins" by Ul de Rico.

Spine: 36MK9101-2 and KP-6001
Inserts: 36MK9101-2
Label: KP-6001

Note: All albums I own actual copies and recorded it with the following gear:
Turntable type: SL1200 MK3D modded heavily (external  Precision Sound Lab Linear PSU), PSL RCA conversion, KAB tone arm dampening, AudioSilente SME connector, Audionote silver internal connectors for SME, ZYX silver tone arm wire direct to RCA out (WBT pure silver RCA connectors and all soldering with Mundorf Supreme 9.5% silver solder. GAE turn table feet, GAE Lifter, GAE power switch, GAE Reset button, TruSweep, TruLift, TruKleen, Powdercoated white top deck, Timestep center bearing/shaft upgrade w/ KAB stabilizer, Mainboard PCB has all new high specification components to replace originals.

Headshell/Cartridge type: Korf Ceramic headshell w/Supex 900 Super cartridge upgraded with boron cantilever and vital line contact diamond. 

Cables: Phono RCA are custom low capacitant shielded 0.5M Vandenhul 501Hybrid Silver with KLE Absolute Harmony silver rca Connectors.  

Phono Stage:  Kitsune Tuned Edition LCR1 MK4   ( I own a Bob's device's sky20 SUT however dont use it anymore )

Software : Audacity to import audio to my Lenovo Carbon X1 gen6

Editing hardware: KTE May Dac, KTE SU2 DDC, Benchmark HPA4 Headphone amplifier, Hifiman Susvara Headphones.

videos.title: 해소년 (Haesonyeon/Sunny Guys) - Without You - 1999
videos.author: No. 1 ChoColatier 🧡
videos.description:
해소년 (Haesonyeon/ Sunny Guys) was a three member boy group under Beat Music in 1999. They debuted with their one and only album, Without You, members being Ryushin, Haebin, and Rooda.

Fun Fact: There was originally a fourth member, however due to some personal problems with family, he ended up having to drop out. This group would go on to become Ditto! 

Special Shout-Out to Jino. This one for u bestie.

None of the music I post legally belongs to me! All rights to the original owners! I'm sharing music to share to the world. Music that's been lost, music that deserves more love, music that needs attention. Thank you for listening!
